label: weak mix: early v/j/a inputs (t=1-2) and copy steps outputting r
explanation: Sparse unit (about 1% of steps) with no clean trigger. Its activation is split about evenly between the original phase and the delimiter/copy phases. In the original phase it fires only at t=1-3, never at t=0 or t>=4, and mostly on inputs v, j, a, i, r. In the delimiter/copy phases it is enriched when the token being output is r (13% rate, about 27% of mass), l or 3. The strongest activations are at the <DEL> step of short sequences that start with r, but even that context fires only about 28% of the time. Every predicate built from these factors has low precision (at most about 0.3): the same input or output context is usually inactive, so the unit seems to depend on hidden-state details the variables do not capture. The best disjunction gets dev F1 about 0.29 and mass recall 0.66. It essentially never fires at t=0, at original positions >=4, or when outputting e, f, z or 2.
